extras: This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: The hover dictionaries all query an online translation service, so they stop working on a plane and — for Chinese — only ever return Simplified.
motivation: To provide a fully offline, feature-rich dictionary and vocabulary learning tool that overcomes the limitations of online-dependent plugins.
problem: Existing dictionary plugins often rely on online services that fail offline or lack comprehensive features like phonetics and spaced repetition.

relations.evidence: WordFolio can pull them across (Import from Anki, needs AnkiConnect): it takes the word and its context and fills in phonetics and definitions from the offline dictionary.
Words you look up with the Kobo's built-in dictionary can come in as well (Import from Kobo).

summary: WordFolio provides an offline dictionary and vocabulary notebook that allows users to look up English words for definitions, phonetics, and spaced repetition.
